identity.kind: IBC plastic tank (1000L class) with metal cage

risks.risk: Food-grade claim may be false (previous chemical/contamination; wrong liner/material).
risks.proof: Request a clear photo of the tank’s certification/material markings (e.g., food-grade/NSF/FDA/UN/DOT/ISO codes) and any paperwork; also ask for an internal photo through the manway.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a general-purpose used IBC (not food-grade).

risks.risk: Leak/crack may exist at seams, valve base, or bottom outlet—photos can miss hairline damage.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of a water-fill leak test (or pressure test) showing no seepage around the valve and bottom.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven leak-free (assume possible minor repairs/discount).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect top lid or damaged gasket could prevent proper sealing.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the top manway/lid and gasket/locking ring.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lid/seal not guaranteed complete.

risks.risk: Capacity/model may not be exactly 1000L (some IBCs differ), affecting value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the capacity marking plate/label clearly (front label or side stamp).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest matching class shown in comparables (1000L class) but treat as uncertain.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the tank’s certification/material markings (food-grade/UN/DOT/NSF/FDA or equivalent) and the capacity label/plate.
Clear close-up of the top manway/lid and gasket/locking ring (to confirm lids complete).
Video or photo evidence of a leak test (water fill) focusing on valve base and bottom outlet area.
Internal photo through the manway showing cleanliness/lining condition.
response.reason: The item type (IBC tank) is visible, but key value drivers—food-grade status, prior contents, leak-free condition, and lid completeness—are not verifiable from the photos provided. Without decisive proof, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
